name: [RIA26] The Block
desc:
Welcome to The Block from Roblox Innovation Studio; Roblox’s “Main Stage” where the future of entertainment is co-created with YOU!

🔭 Discover What's Next: New artists and content creators that you’ll love.
🎧 Live & Immersive: Join and influence events in real-time.
⭐ Culture Unlocked: Connect directly with artists and celebrities.
🎤 Own the Stage: Express your unique POV, perform live, and flex your style.
👑 Exclusive Drop Zone: Score limited-edition UGC and real-world merch.
🚀 Co-create the Future: Play with new tech and influence what we build next.

Recently @ THE BLOCK: Aespa, Billie Eilish, BSlick, KATSEYE, Laufey, LE SSERAFIM, Miami XO, Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters, Netflix’s Stranger Things: Tales from ‘85, overtonight, Parry Gripp, Roblox Creator Showdown, Sofi Tukker, Stray Kids, and The Knocks, The Rolling Stones, Tolou.

💥 Photosensitivity: Flashing lights. 🛍️ Merch: Real-world items available.

👍 & ⭐ favorite The Block for updates!
